description: Apply one demand curve to a batch of items (max 10,000 ids per call; item ids come from list_items) in a single idempotent action. The ids must belong to the targeted catalog: a client-pinned credential applies to its own client's items, and an operator (unpinned) credential applies to the house catalog unless clientId targets a client's items. Applications are Modulate-only: the mean-normalized shape re-times each item's forecast within the year but cannot change its annual total, which is what makes a catalog-scale application volume-safe — volume-setting (absolute) assignments are deliberately not available over MCP; a person sets volumes in the app. Items already carrying this curve are counted, not duplicated; items carrying a DIFFERENT curve are skipped unless overwriteExisting=true replaces them. Every created assignment is stamped source=McpTool with a sourceRef for provenance, and the response accounts for every requested id (matched/notFound/assigned/alreadyAssigned/replaced/skippedConflict).

anchorDate.description: Optional fallback anchor date for Lifecycle curves; each item's own launch date wins. Ignored for Seasonal curves.

clientId.description: Optional client id (GUID) for operator (unpinned) credentials on 3PL tenants: applies the curve to that client's items instead of the house catalog — get ids from list_clients. Client-pinned credentials omit this; the credential decides.

curveId.description: The demand curve id (GUID) to apply.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

itemIds.description: Item ids (GUIDs) to apply it to, max 10,000 per call.

note.description: Optional note on how the items were selected (e.g. the filter used) — stored as provenance on each created assignment.

overwriteExisting.description: When an item already carries a different curve, replace it instead of skipping it (default false = leave existing per-item choices untouched).

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview (matched / would-assign / would-replace counts) plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is changed until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

warehouseId.description: Optional warehouse id (GUID) to apply the curve at a single warehouse only. Omitted = the assignment covers all warehouses.

name: apply_demand_curve_to_items
title: Apply Demand Curve to Items
